name: excalidraw-electronics
description: Generator for an Excalidraw library of IEC electronic and RF block symbols

scripts.package: node src/cli.ts && cd out && rm -rf extras obsidian-extras.zip && mkdir -p extras/Excalidraw/Scripts && cp Template.excalidraw.md extras/Excalidraw/ && cp 'Rotate 90 degrees.md' 'Square Wires.md' extras/Excalidraw/Scripts/ && cd extras && zip -qr ../obsidian-extras.zip Excalidraw
